summary.warning: These deterministic candidate properties are advisory only. The LLM must verify, refine, downgrade, reject, or replace them against the primary and previous-stage evidence.

candidate_properties.title: Polynomial addition/subtraction bounds
candidate_properties.candidate_statement: Candidate Polynomial addition/subtraction bounds obligation for mlk_poly_add; the exact statement, bounds, assumptions and representation must be derived from primary FIPS/code evidence.
evidence_basis: Configured from the canonical 26-property thesis catalogue.
limitations: Local coefficient bounds for the exact representation and input assumptions.

candidate_properties.title: Pointer validity and memory readability/writability for target function arguments
candidate_properties.candidate_statement: Candidate harness assumptions may require valid readable/writable memory for objects passed to mlk_poly_add, according to the actual function signature.
evidence_basis: Agent 3 code summary / raw code should confirm pointer parameters and accessed fields.
required_assumptions: Object sizes and pointer validity must match the actual C type definitions.
candidate_properties.cbmc_relevance: CBMC can check invalid pointer dereference and memory-safety failures under harness assumptions.
limitations: Advisory only until LLM verifies exact function signature and memory accesses.

candidate_properties.title: Array-index safety for coefficient loop
candidate_properties.candidate_statement: Candidate property: loops or accesses associated with mlk_poly_add should not access coefficient arrays outside their declared bounds.
evidence_basis: Detected terms such as MLKEM_N, coeffs, array/index/loop, or n=256 in previous-stage outputs.
required_assumptions: Loop bound and coefficient array length must be verified from raw source/header files.
candidate_properties.cbmc_relevance: CBMC is suitable for bounded C array-index safety checks.
limitations: Does not prove mathematical correctness of polynomial operation.

candidate_properties.title: Arithmetic range / overflow under explicit coefficient assumptions
candidate_properties.candidate_statement: Candidate property: arithmetic inside mlk_poly_add should avoid C integer overflow under explicit coefficient-range assumptions.
evidence_basis: Detected integer types, coefficient terminology, range/modulus constants, or overflow-related hints.
required_assumptions: Input coefficient ranges must be stated explicitly.
C integer promotions and casts must be checked from raw implementation code.
candidate_properties.cbmc_relevance: CBMC can check signed overflow and arithmetic assertions under bounded assumptions.
limitations: Success would not prove full ML-KEM arithmetic correctness.

candidate_properties.title: Local functional relation with old-state snapshot
candidate_properties.candidate_statement: Candidate property: after mlk_poly_add, each affected output coefficient should match a local relation between the old output state and input state, if supported by code/spec evidence.
evidence_basis: Detected possible mutation/in-place-update or coefficient assignment hints in Agent 3 output.
required_assumptions: The harness must snapshot old output state before calling the function.
The property must not use post-call values on both sides of the assertion.
candidate_properties.cbmc_relevance: CBMC can check local post-call assertions if old-state values are stored explicitly.
limitations: The exact mathematical relation must be verified from raw code and specification evidence.
This is local functional consistency only, not full FIPS compliance.

candidate_properties.title: Non-aliasing assumptions for input/output objects
candidate_properties.candidate_statement: Candidate property or assumption: if mlk_poly_add requires non-overlapping objects, the harness must state the aliasing condition explicitly.
evidence_basis: Detected aliasing-related terms in previous-stage outputs or contracts.
required_assumptions: Actual aliasing requirements must be verified from function contracts/source comments.
candidate_properties.cbmc_relevance: CBMC harnesses can encode aliasing/non-aliasing assumptions.
limitations: Over-strong non-aliasing assumptions can hide real behaviours and must be reviewed carefully.

candidate_properties.title: Consistency with existing contracts or annotations
candidate_properties.candidate_statement: Candidate property: generated harness assumptions/assertions for mlk_poly_add should be consistent with existing source-level contracts or CBMC annotations where present.
evidence_basis: Detected contract/assertion/assumption-related terms in code summary.
required_assumptions: Existing annotations must be verified from raw headers/source files.
candidate_properties.cbmc_relevance: Can guide harness assumptions and avoid contradicting repository contracts.
limitations: Existing contracts are evidence, not proof; they may be assumptions rather than established facts.
